context: Aoi trains a new part-timer on kitchen procedures
purpose: Teach: 鍋/容量/汚れ/売り上げ/取り組む/定着/装備/求人

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まず大きな鍋から見せるね。フードメニューの仕込みに毎朝使ってる。
lines.en: First let me show you the big pot. We use it every morning for prepping the food menu.
lines.style: warm trainer voice, friendly but professional onboarding tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: けっこう大きいですね。容量はどのくらい入るんですか?
lines.en: It's pretty big. How much capacity does it hold?
lines.style: curious new hire, polite student register asking honest questions

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 二十リットルくらいかな。底の汚れが残りやすいから、閉店後は念入りに洗ってね。
lines.en: About twenty liters. Grime tends to stick at the bottom, so scrub it carefully after closing.
lines.style: practical instruction, hands-on demonstration with light cautionary emphasis

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。あの、求人広告で見たんですけど、売り上げって最近どうなんですか?
lines.en: Got it. By the way, I saw the job ad, but how have sales been lately?
lines.style: casual curiosity, polite question shifting topic naturally during downtime

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おかげさまで今月の売り上げは伸びてるよ。新しい装備を入れてから効率が上がったの。
lines.en: Thankfully this month's sales are growing. Efficiency went up after we brought in new equipment.
lines.style: upbeat tone sharing good news, owner-like pride in the shop

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ僕も早く仕事に取り組んで、戦力になりたいです。
lines.en: Then I want to dive into the work soon and become a real asset.
lines.style: earnest motivated newcomer, slightly nervous but determined attitude

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 頼もしいね。真剣に取り組む姿勢があれば、手順が定着するまで一週間くらいで大丈夫だよ。
lines.en: That's reassuring. If you tackle it seriously, the procedures will stick in about a week.
lines.style: encouraging mentor tone, reassuring pace with kind smile implied

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、一つずつ覚えていきます。よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: Yes, I'll learn them one by one. Thank you for having me.
lines.style: humble bow-like closing, polite junior wrapping up the briefing respectfully
